Specification: This module is an Apalache typing wrapper around another specification, bosco, rather than a standalone algorithm specification. It declares typed constants and variables and then instantiates the bosco module so that the original specification can remain free of tool-specific annotations. This file itself does not define the algorithm steps, temporal properties, or fault model; it only contributes type-annotated declarations and an INSTANCE of the underlying bosco module.
